name: browser-compat-mcp-server
description: Browser compatibility and Baseline status for any web feature — offline, from MDN's browser-compat-data, web-features, and caniuse. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Browser compatibility and Baseline status for any web feature — offline, from MDN's browser-compat-data, web-features, and caniuse.
interface.longDescription: Web platform feature reference for coding agents: per-browser support matrices from @mdn/browser-compat-data, Baseline status from web-features, and browserslist target resolution with caniuse-lite usage weighting. All data is bundled — no API key, no network.
